name: uma-club-bot-v3
description: WhatsApp bot for Uma Musume club leaders

scripts.restart: npm run stop && timeout //t 2 && npm run start
scripts.setup: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('config.example.yaml','config.yaml');console.log('config.yaml created — edit it with your circle details')"
scripts.health: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/healthz | node -e "process.stdin.on('data',d=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log(j.success?'✅ Bot is running':'❌ Bot is down');console.log('Time:',j.data?.timestamp)})"
scripts.db:backup: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('data/bot.db')){const ts=new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-');fs.copyFileSync('data/bot.db',\"data/bot.db.\"+ts);console.log('Backup created: data/bot.db.'+ts)}else{console.log('No database found')}"
scripts.unlink: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=process.env.WA_SESSION_DIR||'data/auth';if(fs.existsSync(p)){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true});console.log('Session deleted: '+p)}else{console.log('No session found at '+p)}"
scripts.fetch: ts-node --transpile-only -e "const{loadConfig}=require('./src/config');const{UmaMoeClient}=require('./src/api/uma-moe');const{saveSnapshot}=require('./src/data/snapshot');const config=loadConfig();const client=new UmaMoeClient();const now=new Date();client.fetchCircleData(config.circleId,now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth()+1).then(s=>{const d=new Date(now.toLocaleString('en-US',{timeZone:'Asia/Jakarta'}));const ds=\"\"+d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');saveSnapshot(s,ds);console.log('Snapshot saved for '+ds);client.closeSession()}).catch(e=>{console.error('Fetch failed:',e.message);client.closeSession()})"
scripts.docker:stop: docker stop uma-bot && docker rm uma-bot
scripts.pm2:install: npm install -g pm2 && pm2 install pm2-windows-startup
scripts.pm2:start: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js && pm2 save
scripts.pm2:uninstall: pm2 stop uma-bot && pm2 delete uma-bot && pm2 save --force && pm2-unstartup -y && echo Bot removed from PM2
scripts.pm2:uninstall:full: npm run pm2:uninstall && npm uninstall -g pm2 && echo PM2 uninstalled globally
scripts.pm2:restart: npm run build && pm2 restart uma-bot
